events.text: Phase 1 (skinned render substrate) written: scene3d_skinned_wgsl + shadow variant via shared shader chunks; SkinnedVertex 28B path + palette pool + skinned/shadow pipelines in gpu/3d.zig; skeleton/pose.zig palette math (col-major, matches rebuild_model); PlayerSkin through constructor/player_assets/scene_build/animation/runtime_stream; __compiled_world_set_player_skin door; playerModelPush.ts emits stride-16 skin payload with rigid per-part weights (presence-gated, legacy path intact). Phase 2 landed (voxel-geodesic solver in framework/skeleton/autoweights.zig, solve-at-staging with RJIT_SKIN_SOLVE=0 escape). Ship + headless shot PASS. Seam softening now engages on the next playtest push; console will log [skin-solve] with bone/vert/voxel counts.

resolution: Phase 1 of the green-lit auto-skinning plan landed: the skinned figure substrate. The framework now has a matrix-palette LBS path — scene3d_skinned_wgsl (+ shadow variant) built from shared shader chunks so the fragment/instance math can never drift; a 28-byte SkinnedVertex retained path with palette pool (mat4+tint per bone) in gpu/3d.zig; skeleton/pose.zig composing palettes that mirror rebuild_model exactly; a __compiled_world_set_player_skin door; scene_build/animation/runtime_stream wiring so clips AND live capture pose drive the palette; and playerModelPush.ts emitting the stride-16 skin payload with rigid per-part weights, presence-gated with the legacy path intact. Rigid weights reproduce today's per-part transforms exactly, so the swap is visually invisible until the Phase-2 voxel-geodesic solver softens seams into the same wire format. Verified: ship compiles clean; rjit shot editor --route /play PASS twice (world + figure render headless; PNG in session scratchpad). Next slices: voxel-geodesic solver in Zig, mush/smoothing rescue, bind-time pose-sweep validator.
